newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain confirms eight pct electricity tariff cut.
newsitem.headline: Spain confirms eight pct electricity tariff cut.

text.p: The Spanish Ministry of Industry confirmed on Tuesday that it has reached an agreement with electricity companies to reduce tariffs by eight percent in the next five years.
A spokesman for the Industry Ministry said the tariff will fall by three percent in 1997, by two percent in 1998 and by one percent in each of the subsequent three years.

Under this agreement, which forms part of talks on the sector's new regulatory framework, small and medium-sized businesses will benefit the most from the cuts and will pay up to 20 percent less by 2001.
Next year, the tariff for small and medium businesses will be reduced by five percent, that of the small consumer by one percent and rates for large business will be frozen.
